mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 64 degrees.

The City of Verona has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with community input and mapping exercises, creates a roadmap for future infrastructure, sustainability, and diverse housing needs.

We have a busy week ahead! Join us for Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by several trivia options tomorrow including Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, and don't miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on October 14.
Regarding the weekly report, on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash involving injuries on CTH-PB at CTH-M after an eMoto operator engaged in reckless driving.
Enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day at the Verona Culver is, which opens today at 10 AM.
